questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal project.
options: I didn't finish my degree before realizing the importance of personal projects.
Until I finished my degree, it wasn't clear to me how important personal projects were.
The realization about personal projects only came after I had completed my studies.
It was not until I had finished my degree that I understood the significance of personal projects.
questions.answer: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal project.

questions.question: The company, which had been struggling financially for years, finally went bankrupt last month.
options: The company struggled financially for many years before going bankrupt in January.
It was the company's financial struggles that led to its bankruptcy in February.
In the end, it was the company's financial difficulties that caused its downfall.
The company had been facing financial problems for several years when it went bankrupt last month.
questions.answer: The company, which had been struggling financially for years, finally went bankrupt last month.

questions.question: Unless I were to attend the conference, I would never have met my current business partner.
options: If I hadn't attended the conference, I might not have met my business partner.
I wouldn't have met my business partner unless I had gone to the conference.
Attending the conference was essential for meeting my business partner.
Unless I were to attend the conference, it's unlikely that I would have met my business partner.
questions.answer: Unless I were to attend the conference, I would never have met my current business partner.

questions.question: It is essential that the new policy be implemented as soon as possible.
options: The new policy must be put into effect immediately.
It's crucial to implement the new policy without delay.
The new policy needs to be introduced at the earliest opportunity.
It is imperative that the new policy be implemented as soon as possible.
questions.answer: It is essential that the new policy be implemented as soon as possible.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten dinner.
options: When I got there, they were still eating their evening meal.
I found out that they had finished eating by the time I arrived.
They had only just sat down to eat when I arrived at their place.
It was not until after I had eaten that I realized they had already finished dinner.
questions.answer: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten dinner.
